scoring_justification: The headline quantities (total energies, binding energies) cannot be recomputed by the lightweight checker; the checker compares agent-reported values to hidden reference values from a standard run with the same ECP/basis. Geometry symmetry is verified by structural audit.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference total energies (hartree) for eight species and binding energies (kcal/mol) for three three-center species.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Reference solve.sh run with HF/LANL2DZ+double-zeta on H, matching public instruction protocol.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values are the exact outputs written by the reference oracle solve.sh; they represent a correct submission with the mandated method.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These numbers are the direct outputs of a standard open-source (PySCF) run with the same ECP/basis described in the task; they are not fabricated from thin air.

outputs.description: Optimized bond lengths for the three-center species. The scorer checks that for T+ the two central Si–H distances are equal to within a tolerance, and that for T0 and T- the two central Si–H distances differ substantially, consistent with asymmetric three-center bonding.

Total electronic energies (SCF) of all reference silanes and three-center model species. The scorer compares reported energies to hidden reference values obtained from a standard run with the same ECP/basis.

Binding energies of T+, T0, and T- computed from total energies. The scorer checks that the T+ binding energy is negative and substantial (within a hidden range), while T0 and T- are near zero, reflecting the stability of the symmetric three-center bond only in the cation.

output_contract.notes: The scoring does not depend on exact agreement with the original paper's LP-31G basis set values. A standard ECP/valence basis (e.g., LANL2DZ on Si, double-zeta on H) is used; the hidden reference values are derived from a run with the same standard protocol. The geometric symmetry conditions are checked via structural audit; energies and binding energies are compared to those reference values.

steps.description: Verify that the two central Si–H distances in T+ are equal within tolerance and that for T0 and T- they differ by more than the threshold, indicating asymmetry.
Compare each reported total electronic energy to the hidden reference; score 1.0 for each molecule within tolerance, average over all species.
Compare each reported binding energy to the hidden reference; score 1.0 for each within tolerance, average.
